name: OpenClaw
author: openclaw
description: Self-hosted AI assistant gateway: the Control UI plus every chat channel (Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Slack) in one container. Official GHCR image rather than a host Node install — the box runs Node 22 and OpenClaw wants 24+. State, workspace and auth profiles live under ~/services/openclaw; a gateway token is generated into .env and the Control UI asks for it on first open. Host ~/.claude and ~/.codex are mounted in when present so the bundled Claude/Codex providers can reuse their logins; setup.sh never creates or overwrites them.

control._comment: The cli sidecar is behind a compose profile and never runs long, so it is not a part.
